SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meetups AS A WHERE A.delete_yn = 'N' AND A.status != 'DELETED'
AND A.status = #{status}
AND A.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchText}, '%')
ORDER BY A.created_at DESC

SELECT A.*, C.image_path FROM meetups AS A LEFT OUTER JOIN sigungus AS B ON B.sigungu_id = A.sigungu_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sidos AS C ON C.sido_id = B.sido_id LEFT OUTER JOIN meetup_images AS D ON D.meetup_id = A.meetup_id LEFT OUTER JOIN images AS E ON E.image_id = D.image_id WHERE A.sigungu_id = #{sigunguId} ORDER BY
A.CREATED_AT ASC
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meetup_applications WHERE meetup_id = A.meetup_id AND status = 'APPROVED') DESC
A.CREATED_AT DESC
LIMIT #{start}, ${end};
SELECT A.*, C.image_path FROM meetups AS A JOIN meetup_images AS B ON B.meetup_id = A.meetup_id JOIN images AS C ON C.image_id = B.image_id WHERE A.meetup_id = ${meetup_id};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meetup_applications (meetup_id, member_id, status) VAEUE (#{meetup_id}, #{member_id}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE meetups SET title = ${title}, content = ${content}, max_participants = ${max_participants}, min_participants = ${min_participants}, address = ${address}, meetup_datetime = ${meetup_datetime}, status = ${status} WHERE meetup_id = ${meetup_id};
